evals.query: 從這份 master_draft 幫我做 PPTX 給教授

Runs P1 (outline lock) → P2 (section) → P3 (slide) → P4 (vision review) → P5 (speaker script) with 3-layer confirmation

Output .pptx without P5 speaker script (Tier 1/2/3 三層分流 required)

weekly-report skill activates instead to produce W1-W7 master draft
